h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Erode

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Erode

items.pText: Erode's turmeric markets and textile trade have made it a town of family businesses, and many of our enquiries here come from people building something of their own. That might be a new private school, a housing layout or a marriage hall with a lawn. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for all of them at our factory in Vasai, about 1,030 km away, and delivers it to Tamil Nadu by road.

A new project gives you the chance to plan the play area properly from the start. Fix its position before the landscaping and paving are done, so the foundations go in with the rest of the civil work. We can share the layout drawing and the foundation points with your architect or contractor early on. That way the play area gets proper drainage and does not end up squeezed into whatever space is left.

richText.heading: Heat, rain and materials in Erode

c: Erode is hot through most of the year, and a good share of its rain comes with the northeast monsoon. Roto-moulded slides and decks stay cooler to the touch than bare steel, and they do not rust. Galvanised pipe frames handle the wet months. Plan at least partial shade over slides that face west, and use rubber flooring rather than loose sand, which gets very hot in the sun.

items.q: When should we plan the playground in a new building project?
items.a: As early as possible, before paving and landscaping. We share the layout drawing so your contractor can prepare the foundations along with the rest of the civil work.

items.q: Can you customise colours or designs for our school?
items.a: Yes. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades and design customisation on request. Our in-house design team can adapt a structure to suit your theme.

items.q: Have you supplied anywhere near Erode?
items.a: Yes, we installed a resort playground in Dindigul, Tamil Nadu. We deliver across the state by road from our Vasai factory and install with our team or a dealer.
